basic_profile.bio: Avid manga enthusiast from Memphis who recently discovered the world of Reddit. I spend my evenings exploring new manga series and discussing their potential adaptations. I work as a part-time barista at a local coffee shop and am currently single. My online hours are mostly in the evenings after my shifts, and I often stay up late on weekends diving into manga and chatting with fellow fans.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of manga stems from years of reading and watching anime adaptations. I often rely on recommendations from friends and online communities. While I don't have formal education in literature or media studies, I've self-taught myself about manga history and trends through various fan sites and forums.
